query: How does zod generate deterministic hash IDs for schema objects used in deduplication
notes: Zod does NOT use deterministic hash IDs for schema deduplication. Schemas are tracked by WeakMap object reference in $ZodRegistry._map; user-supplied 'id' strings are stored in $ZodRegistry._idmap for reverse lookup. util.ts has HashAlgorithm types but those are for validating hash string formats (md5, sha256), not schema identity. The globalRegistry deduplication is a singleton-on-globalThis trick to survive dual CJS/ESM package loading.

Schema documentation metadata is attached via globalRegistry.add(schema, { title, description, ... }) from registries.ts; the public .meta() check helper is defined in api.ts line ~1684.
